title: Presentation Builder — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Creates slide decks from an outline or topic, ready to present. The Presentation Builder creates slide decks from an outline or topic. It turns the outline into titled slides with bullet structure, speaker-note placeholders, and a logical flow — title, agenda, content, summary, questions. The student supplies the actual content and data; the builder supplies the professional structure.
